The listed measurements are predominantly functional-effect percent-inhibition data on human TSLP across assay panels CHEMBL4047224, CHEMBL4047225, CHEMBL4047226, CHEMBL5541487, CHEMBL5541488 and CHEMBL5332048, with values spanning a wide range across distinct compounds.

No patent-linked candidates were identified in this selection (0 patent occurrences), which is a statement about the retrieved data and not evidence that related compounds are unclaimed.

Because missing records do not demonstrate that no inhibitors exist, the per-source retrieval statuses above constitute the entire basis for this summary.

- Patent-text evidence was not retrieved; no patent documents were available, so patent linkage cannot be assessed.
- Only 50 of 114 measurements are listed in detail; whole items were omitted and are described only in coverage counts.
- The small-molecule candidate set shown is limited to one ChEMBL entry; the large peptide-heavy measurement set is not represented by shown candidates.
- PubChem BioAssay entries are screening context only, with no screening outcome reported as a target measurement.
- BindingDB results lack assay-level species and construct context, and 3 ChEMBL records were excluded for missing standard values.
